column3: With respect to the 770 The City Drive Mortgage Loan (3.4%), the second largest tenant, Applied General Agency, LLC, is a tenant at four suites in the Mortgaged Property (5100, 5200, 5300 and 5710). With respect to Suites 5100 and 5200, rent abatement applies for 9 successive months beginning April 2026. With respect to Suites 5300 and 5710, rent abatement applies for 7 successive months beginning February 2026. A rent concession reserve required for related abatement amounts.
